capture_note: Захват текста ответа из сессии детализации фазы P3; провайдер не возвращает подписанный payload. SHA256 считается по файлам этого каталога и фиксирует их неизменность после сохранения, но не доказывает байтовую идентичность сетевому ответу. Длинные иллюстративные листинги сокращены до сигнатур с пометкой [листинг сокращён]; смысловые утверждения, имена механизмов и URL сохранены.
query_scope_rule: D6: нейтральная формулировка, без имени CoreX/FlexCRM, внутренних путей, ID и схем. Внешний источник подтверждает только названную общую практику (RAG:✅).
known_provider_defect: Ответ, начинающийся с таблицы, усекается — известен с P1. На этой фазе не воспроизведён: каждый запрос явно просил начать с прозы.

queries.query: Explain in prose first, do not start with a table. For a PHP monorepo that already has a custom import-graph gate and custom PHPStan rules, when is an additional architecture tool such as Deptrac or PHPat justified? What class of dependency rule can those tools express that a use-statement scanner plus PHPStan Rule cannot? Official Deptrac, PHPat, and PHPStan custom-rules documentation. Name primary-source URLs.

Explain in prose first, do not start with a table. How does roave/backward-compatibility-check detect breaking changes in PHP public API between two git revisions in 2026? Current package version, what it compares, known limitations versus a changelog-only contract guard, and recommended baseline policy before a first 1.0 tag in a Composer monorepo of many packages. Official Roave documentation and packagist. Name primary-source URLs.

Explain in prose first, do not start with a table. How to write a PHPStan custom rule that forbids non-serializable types on a marker interface for queue or durable payloads: Eloquent models, Closure, container, request objects. PHPStan 2.x Rule API, identifier, and negative tests with phpstan/phpstan-src test fixtures. Official phpstan.org writing-rules docs. Name primary-source URLs.

Explain in prose first, do not start with a table. Architecture fitness functions that must fail on a planted violation: why a CI architecture gate needs a negative test that injects a forbidden import or type and asserts the gate exits non-zero with the offending filename. Neal Ford fitness functions and PHP/Laravel CI gate practice. Name primary-source URLs.

Explain in prose first, do not start with a table. PHPStan @internal enforcement versus detecting accidentally public classes. What does tomasvotruba/class-leak actually report, and can the same accidentally-public check be expressed as: top-level type is not in declared public namespaces, not in Internal namespace, and lacks @internal. PHPStan method.internal docs and class-leak README. Name primary-source URLs.

Explain in prose first, do not start with a table. Does roave/backward-compatibility-check 8.22.0 or any 8.x release support PHP 8.3? Which latest 8.x version still allows PHP 8.3, and can a CI job run the checker only on PHP 8.4 while the library itself supports 8.3-8.5? Official packagist constraints and GitHub README. Name primary-source URLs.
